primitives.name: Fail-Open Resilience Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Robustness / fail-open:** `/fantasy` OOM fix (sequential nflverse loaders); fail-open `.catch` on `/api/picks`, admin users/posts/picks, `/api/promotions`, cockpit review/tasks/agent-detail (using `Prisma.*GetPayload<typeof args>[]` to preserve `include`/`select` typing); Sleeper input sanitization; two denial-of-wallet rate-limits.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_{fail}': 'Boolean gate state (0/1)', 'T_{timeout}': 'Time threshold for timeout handling', 'R_{rate}': 'Rate limit per second'}
primitives.assumptions: All system components must be resilient to partial failure without compromising overall service availability.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a probabilistic fault-tolerant automaton that transitions to safe state upon detection of resource exhaustion or invalid input.
layer2.telemetry: Observable metrics include memory usage, request latency, and error counts per endpoint.

primitives.name: Engine Integrity Test Suite
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Engine-integrity tests (highest-trust):** `computeGameContext` 9-signal fuser; `clarkWestTest` with a **load-bearing** n≥30 + tStat>1.64 fail-closed gate; `orderReplayGames` no-lookahead spine; brier/ECE boundaries; settlement no-lookahead invariance, full-output determinism, reversed-orientation swap; `studioWorkspaceProps`, segment-error-boundary shapes, `consumeRateLimit` is
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I_{test}': 'Integrity score (0–1)', 'n': 'Sample size for statistical test', 'tStat': 'Student’s t-statistic', 'G_{closed}': 'Boolean fail-closed gate state'}
primitives.assumptions: Tests must maintain deterministic outcomes across repeated executions and validate against known ground truth.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If n < 30 OR tStat < 1.64, then G_{closed} = 0

layer2.mapping: Derived kernel of statistical validation functions used to ensure correctness of core game computation logic.
layer2.telemetry: Validation scores, sample sizes, and p-values from hypothesis tests.

primitives.name: Route-Level Error Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Route resilience:** segment error boundaries for stats / fantasy / intelligence / players.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{boundary}': 'Error boundary function (boolean)', 'R_{route}': 'Route identifier', 'S_{state}': 'State vector of route component'}
primitives.assumptions: Each route segment can independently recover from internal failures without propagating errors upstream.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E_{boundary}(R_{route}) = true iff S_{state} contains invalid state

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a modular control flow graph with exception handlers at each node to isolate and contain faults.
layer2.telemetry: Failure rate per route, recovery time, and number of isolated exceptions.
